reviews.t: The Pearl Rhinestone Headband from The Great Gatsby movie was absolutely beautiful and stunning
reviews.x: The Pearl Rhinestone Headband from The Great Gatsby movie was absolutely beautiful and stunning. I got a lot of compliments from it at our reunion. I took a picture of it to cherish it forever. I got it on time the week after I ordered it and it came in a black box which kept it from being broken while shipping. I really appreciated that. I was worried it might be partially broken, but it wasn't. I arrived in perfect condition. The quality was perfect for the price. I've attached a picture of me

reviews.x: This headband is stunning.  The quality is amazing.  It is heavy and you have to tie it just right to minimize movement, but once you figure out a comfortable spot, and it is tied well it will stay on you head all night.  I wore it to a Downton Abbey even and it was perfect

This is so beautiful! It looks like real diamonds. I'm super obsessed with Great Gatsby and daisy's look so I bought this for prom and I don't regret it, definitely worth the money. It arrived in perfect condition, nothing was broken. A lot of people were complaining that it was too small and hurt their head, and it was small when I took it out of the box, but I just VERY CAREFULLY bent it open enough to fit my head perfectly. it didn't snap or crack when I did this. When putting it on, try to h

reviews.t: Very beautiful headpiece. Purchased for a 1920's gala
reviews.x: Very beautiful headpiece. Purchased for a 1920's gala. Shipped quickly and was packaged very nicely in a pink box. Also came with gold and black straps to change for different color attire. Love, love, love!!

Absolutely beautiful!  My daughter wore it to prom and was featured in the newspaper because of the head piece.  Great quality. Accidentally ordered 2 and they returned the extra and refunded the product quickly.

reviews.t: I was EXTREMELY pleased with this brand of products and for the price ...
reviews.x: I was EXTREMELY pleased with this brand of products and for the price it was well worth the purchase.  It arrived in just a few days with PRIME for my Roaring 20's Party. It looked great and matched earrings and hand ring well.  Will definitely order from this vendor again.  The earrings are not heavy. The headband may seem a little awkward at first, but once you tie it stays secure. OH! The packaging was beautiful!!

This headpiece was just gorgeous.  I loved it aside from it is extremely heavy to wear on your head to the point if i lowered my head slightly it would move to the point of falling off. Just make sure to tie it tight.  The only place I could place it where it wouldn't fall off squeezed my head so tight it gave me a headache by the end of the event.  They do say beauty is pain.
I love this headpiece.  The only problem is it is a little fragile.  It was packed wonderfully and missing a pearl.  The metal is thin and cannot be stressed too much.

I LOVE THIS headband! It is a perfect replica of the one Daisy wore in the Gatsby movie. I wore it to my 1920's themed Prom and I felt and looked amazing. I got compliments all night about how cute it was and how I looked like Daisy (with brown hair). It was sturdy metal and none of the jewels fell off. I bobby pinned it tight on the ribbon around my head and it didn't move the whole night, even while I was dancing. I love how it comes with two ribbons so that people with dark hair can use the b

At first I thought it was going to be too heavy to wear.  But my hairdresser tied it and in never moved and was very comfortable to wear.  did not realize it was going to be a Tiara .  It was truly a work of art and good quality piece.  I just loved it !!! It was so comfortable and beautifully made.  Love Love It.  For those of you that watch the Big

Purchased for a Great Gatsby party. Came in perfect condition in a pretty pink box as pictured in the description. You can change out the "straps" from gold to black and it's easy to do. You can wear it on your forehead or as a "tiara" style a bit which is how I ended up wearing it because of my bangs. I took off one star because it hurts after an at least an hour of wearing it and I have a feeling one side of my head ended up with a slight bruise from it. Ultimately it was a goo

Absolutely stunning in person. I wore this for an NYE Gatsby party and it really pulled my outfit together. I was worried as some of the earlier reviews complained that the item arrived damaged, but there was nothing wrong with mine and it arrived packaged very well. My only complaint is that is a little difficult to secure onto your head. I was only able to do so if I wore it like a tiara rather than a headband. I also had to use quite a few bobby pins to stop it from sliding down, but it was w

I purchased this for a Gatsby themed wedding I'll be attending next month. I have to admit, it is much better quality than I was expecting! I had to gently bend it out a bit because it was a bit too tight, but it was an easy fix. It came in a gift box and included both cream and black ribbon to tie it with, so you have choices. It's absolutely stunning and I can't wait to wear it!!

Love it!!!! Love it!!!! Love it!!!!! Beautiful? Better in person! Excellent quality, heavier than I thought it would be. I did have a little bit of an issue using bobby pins to anchor it but that was the only concern I had. This headpiece was adjustable, which I very much appreciated. I'm so VERY glad I spent a little more for this....😊....
I got tons of compliments on this! It's gorgeous!!!

Beautiful headband but VERY SMALL.  I have a really big head (I wear a size large in women's snowboard helmets) so I actually wasn't surprised when this didn't fit me. (I actually ordered two headbands off Amazon in case this happened and the other one fit great).  But then my friend with a reasonably small head tried it on and it didn't fit her either.  To be clear, the ribbon was long enough, but the silver part of the headband is curved, so your head has to actually fit in it for it to sit co

This head piece is beautiful. It comes with cream colored ribbon and black if you want to change it out.  It was a bit heavy and slid  down my head because it was pretty hot outside.  It is very well made and looks very expensive. I got tons of compliments but I might opt for the one just like this that has elastic on the back for a better fit.  Very good for the price!

reviews.t: Gorgeous, it was a prop for a photo booth ...
reviews.x: Gorgeous, it was a prop for a photo booth and everyone wanted this one.  Looks very expensive for a costume piece.  Kinda inspired to think of reasons why I could wear this besides for a costume but maybe for a bachelorette party with a theme??? Just a suggestion for others.  Also, you can position it in your hair in different ways, so it's more discreet.

I am returning it because it fit super tight and felt like if I tried to bend it out I may break it? It was beautiful and well made just really tight and wanted to wear it where the leaves faced up, but the only way I felt it could be worn is like pictured on the pic of Daisy from the movie.

reviews.t: I've never gotten so many compliments.
reviews.x: This headband is absolutely gorgeous. The ribbons could be a bit longer, but I was able to tie it in a proper bow after several failed attempts. I was skeptical about it staying in place, so I used bobbypins to pin the ribbon behind my ears and it stayed put for 6+ hours. Highly recommend!

Ordered it as a gift and my friend loves it! It came in a black box wrapped in bubble wrap, I very much appreciated the careful packaging, It's exactly like the picture and even more beautiful n person, very happy with it! totally recommending it anyone who is considering

I was very surprised with the quality of this headband, based on the inexpensive price. It looks beautiful and it's so easy to put on. It comes with two sets of ribbons, in black and nude to match the outfit you'll wear. I have a big head and it feels very comfortable.

reviews.t: Great looking item for New Year's celebration with 1920's theme
reviews.x: Item as describe. Some pearls came off during shipping. Not a problem, just glued them back on.  Bought for wife.  Great looking item for New Year's celebration with 1920's theme.
Gorgeous and easy to wear but the ornate part is truly metal so it doesn't bend so it can be hard to get to stay and not be a little annoying but definitely worth it
This is really beautiful.  It's a heavy metal piece and very good quality.  It's going to be gorgeous for my event.  I will update with photos once I wear it.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the headpiece as beautiful, stunning, or gorgeous, often saying it looks even better in person.
Many customers say it is well made and worth the price, though some note it is heavy and needs to be tied tightly to stay in place.
Several reviewers mention it arrived well packaged and in perfect condition, while a few report it arrived damaged or missing a pearl.
Customers commonly bought it for Gatsby, 1920s, prom, or themed events and received many compliments.
A few reviewers note the metal is thin or fragile and that it can be too tight or too small for some wearers.
